description.value: Stuffies Pastries brings a South Korean-inspired pastry concept to Metro Vancouver, specialising in animal-shaped, waffle-like treats stuffed with custard crème, jam, and buttercream fillings. The brand holds exclusive Canadian rights to the DeliManjoo automatic baking machines that produce the signature pastry, and has grown to three locations across North Vancouver, Metrotown (Burnaby), and Guildford (Surrey). Beyond pastries, the menu includes coffee, soft-serve, and sandwiches, salads, and soups — making it a viable quick-stop for a touring cyclist moving through Metro Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 58m; rack (6 spaces) at 87m. Total: 16 spaces.
